wiring: none: packaged only; not called by rails or workflows.py

score_provenance.run: omp 19.0.1 -p with --config overlay (modelRoles.judge: typesafe/jev-1.14.0; retry.fallbackChains.judge: []); TYPESAFE_API_KEY injected by infisical run (project 052b4c81-…, env dev)
score_provenance.call: eval judge_batch(states, questions.json questions), one call per case, retries 2

action.value: log only (shadow); later a completion gate before merge

baseline.value: none: completion claims are not checked today

costs.value: a miss (unsupported completion accepted) costs more than a false action (owner review)

framing.written_policy: label-guide.md rules E1-E9; deterministic pre-check P1-P10 runs first

evidence_gap.band_source: escalation_band: the measured band, read by decide() at the rails; no_at_most is inclusive

minimums.reason: jev-actions defaults; recall raised to 0.9 because a miss costs more

evidence_gap.cost_rule: miss costs more: provisional single threshold 0.3 if one must gate shadow logging

escalation_band.between: escalate to the owner (fallback judge: a person)
escalation_band.rule: pass_below: largest dev cut with zero positives below it; flag_at_or_above: smallest dev cut with flagged precision >= 0.8 (at least 5 flagged)
escalation_band.fallback_assumption: cascade recall assumes the person resolves every escalated case as the arbitrated label

results.tuning: tune_threshold.py --min-precision 0.8 --min-recall 0.9 --beta 2 --conservative --repeats 5: 0 of 25 folds qualified; no threshold meets minimums. Zero-minimum run (information only, gates nothing): best F2 threshold 0.395, folds 0.395-0.685, test P 0.32 R 1.00
results.calibration: Brier raw 0.2874 dev held-out, Platt 0.1648; test raw 0.3498, Platt 0.1694. Platt (a 0.8985, b -1.6443, fitted on all dev) accepted for any read of the probability; thresholds and band stay in raw space. Reliability bins not checked: do not show as confidence
results.errors: raw scores sit high on negatives (median about 0.69); top dev false positives CE038 0.98, CE030 0.95, CE062 0.90 are skill or runbook doc changes the labels treat under E4 and Jev treats as behaviour

label_set.units: 82 PRs (unit = owner/repo#number); dev/test split by FNV-1a hash of unit (70/30), no unit in both

sources.adversarial_note: request of one PR paired with the evidence of another in the same repository; unit = the request PR

label_set.provenance: agent_reviewed: innovation-council first pass via omp -p (council plus innovation-challenger and experiment-peer labelling independently, then council adjudication), blind to jev scores; claude arbitrated after reading every split case, before scoring. 82 of 92 unanimous; 10 challenger/peer splits; arbiter overruled 1 (CE089 0 -> 1). Owner may override with human rows
label_set.precheck_excluded: 11 of 295 PRs with request and evidence sections failed P5-P7 (no or failing checks) and were not sampled
label_set.selection: per-repository quotas from 284 eligible merged or closed PRs in 8 adam-jackson-cf repositories; half of each quota from PRs with a Not tested paragraph, the rest by stable hash

shortfalls: No threshold meets precision 0.8 / recall 0.9 on dev; threshold null
Escalation band misses on test: flagged precision 0.50 (4 false of 8); band not confirmed
Dev positives 26 (< about 30); real replay positives only 22 of 32; scout has 0 and skills-directory 1
Policy gap for owner ruling: agent-instruction docs (skills, runbooks) as E4 docs or E5 behaviour; near-duplicates CE029 (1) and CE030 (0) differ only by not_tested wording
No linked plans or issues: 0 of 295 PRs link an issue, so the request is the PR's own summary; PR comments with later evidence were not read
Fallback judge not run; cascade numbers assume a person resolves escalations exactly
Framing values (action, baseline, costs, minimums) are assumed; owner to confirm
Q10 kept no: the question judges whether any claimed outcome lacks evidence, because replayed requests are not itemised into criteria
